result.title: MoG-VLM: Efficient Video Anomaly Detection through Motion-Guided Vision-Language Models
result.comment: Accepted at BMVC 2026. Includes supplementary material
result.summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection, but dense frame-level inference makes them impractical for real-time deployment. Existing acceleration commonly relies on uniform sampling, which ignores content dynamics and can either waste computation on static segments or miss localized anomalies. We propose MoG-VLM a motion-adaptive anomaly detection framework that leverages motion purely as a lightweight control signal to decide when VLM inference is necessary. To this end, we introduce Temporal Gradient Magnitude (TGM) which performs content-aware sampling to concentrate computation on informative regions while avoiding redundant processing. We further introduce a hierarchical dual-stream design in which dense multi-frame VLM reasoning is activated only around frames with elevated anomaly likelihood, via anchor-triggered context-window expansion with early termination. A fusion module then reconciles these instantaneous semantic cues with temporal action dynamics. Across four benchmarks, our method achieves 91.91%, 84.30%, 87.88%, and 78.96% AUC-ROC on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, MSAD, and ShanghaiTech, respectively, establishing new state of the art on three benchmarks under the zero-shot, training-free setting. On XD-Violence, we improve over the previous best result by +0.57% while delivering a 1.31x inference speedup. These results demonstrate that content-aware allocation of VLM capacity, processing fewer frames more intelligently rather than all frames uniformly, is a more effective axis of progress than uniformly densifying VLM inference across frames. Code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/kdawoud91/MoG-VLM.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 MoG-VLM，一种无需训练的零样本视频异常检测框架：用时间梯度幅值（TGM）作为轻量运动信号做内容感知采样，仅在异常可能性升高的片段以 anchor 触发多帧 VLM 推理并提前终止，再由融合模块结合时序动作动态。
AI.relevance_reason: 以廉价运动信号门控昂贵 VLM 推理并引入提前终止，为 THINK/LOOK/STOP 的触发条件与停止收益—成本核算提供可核查的实例；但工作不涉及内部 latent 状态，也未分析推理内容的使用方式。
